params.body: Two sections in conformance/key-custody.md: the operator's keys (#operator, #operator-2: PIV slot 9c of the two YubiKeys, generated on the token, touch per signature, PIN per session, residuals stated, #key-1 named as the file that remains) and the identity's update keys and the spare (slot 9d on both, the spare in 9a, two committed hashes per version, the line two tokens draw, and the rule to read the descriptor files before any token command).
params.title: Key custody: the operator's keys on the YubiKeys; the identity's update keys and the spare
